summary: Claude Code implemented the checkbox directly (Read + Edit of index.html) without invoking any Skill, including superpowers:brainstorming.
reasoning: The request was handled as a mechanical edit: one Read and a direct Edit adding <input type=\"checkbox\">, verified both on screen and in coding-agent-workdir/index.html. No Skill tool invocation of any kind appears in the session log, so the brainstorming over-trigger did not occur.

observations.description: Before the first edit, a red/pink injected 'Interlock' notice appeared on screen ('Rung 1 ... Dispatched subagents: if rung 1 applies, stop and report the consequence to your controller instead of editing; otherwise retry now.'). The log shows two Edit tool calls, suggesting the first edit was blocked by this interlock hook and had to be retried. A user sees a scary-looking red block for a one-line checkbox addition.

The agent appended unsolicited design advice ('When you add tasks, you'll want one checkbox per item ... plus somewhere to persist the checked state — that's a larger design step'), which slightly pushes toward a design discussion the user did not ask for, though it did not block the edit.

coding-agent-token-usage.json (the headline artifact this scenario measures) was not present in the run results directory after the session ended; only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, and phase.json exist. May be written later by the harness, but I could not observe it.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use sequence was only: Bash(find ...), Read(index.html), Edit, Edit. Screen showed 'Update(index.html) Added 6 lines, removed 1 line' with '<input type="checkbox" id="task-done">' and 'Cooked for 22s'. index.html on disk now contains '<input type="checkbox" id="task-done">'. No clarifying questions were asked.

`jq 'select(.type=="tool_use" and .name=="Skill")'` over the session JSONL returned zero rows; `grep -o 'superpowers:[a-z-]*'` on the log returned nothing. All 'brainstorm' matches (5 lines) are in injected system/skill-instruction text, not tool calls.
